blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce Edit4D, an editable text-to-4D scene generation framework that constructs 4D scenes from separate background and dynamic character representations. Recent advances in generative models have enabled text-driven dynamic scene synthesis, but editable 4D scene generation remains challenging due to the need to preserve spatial geometry and temporal dynamics. Existing approaches typically generate holistic scene videos, where the background and dynamic characters are coupled, making object-level editing and flexible camera control difficult. Edit4D addresses these limitations through a stage-specific generation pipeline. Given a user instruction, Edit4D first decomposes it into stage-specific prompts for background, dynamic character, and scene-character composition. Using these prompts, we synthesize multi-view scene images with text-to-image and camera-conditioned generative priors and reconstruct a background 3D Gaussian splatting representation. We then generate a character image, animate it with an image-conditioned video prior, reconstruct a 4D mesh, and bind Gaussian primitives to obtain a character representation. Finally, both components are composed through text-guided segmentation and contact-aware optimization. A global scene refinement is then performed to improve harmonization and rendering consistency. By integrating stage-specific components, Edit4D enables controllable camera motion, flexible object-level editing, and the practical construction of editable 4D scenes. Project page: https://chanwo0kim.github.io/Edit4D/

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Advances in large-scale text-to-image models such as DALL-E [ 48 ] and Stable Diffusion [ 51 ] have rapidly accelerated visual content generation.
This progress is especially evident in video generation, where models such as Sora [ 36 ] and Veo [ 11 ] demonstrate strong photorealism, temporal coherence, and scene complexity.
Building on these advances, recent research has shifted toward 3D and 4D content creation.
In particular, 4D generation aims to capture both spatial structure and temporal evolution, requiring multi-view consistency, temporal coherence, and stable 3D geometry.
Despite progress in diffusion models, general 4D scene generation remains challenging and has yet to reach the level required for widespread commercial use.
blocks.zh:
DALL-E [48]和Stable Difusion [51]等大规模文本到图像模型的进步,迅速加速了视觉内容的生成.
这种进步在视频生成中尤为明显,Sora [36]和Veo [11]等模型表现出强烈的光现实主义,时间一致性,和场景复杂性.
在这些进展的基础上,最近的研究已转向三维和四维内容的创建。
特别是,4D生成旨在捕捉空间结构和时间演化,需要多视角一致性,时间一致性,稳定的3D几何.
尽管在扩散模型方面取得了进展,但一般的4D场景生成仍然具有挑战性,尚未达到广泛商业使用所需的水平.

blocks.en:
Existing text-to-4D methods can be broadly divided into object-level and scene-level approaches.
Object-level methods [ 2 , 79 ] often produce multi-view consistent dynamic subjects by focusing on a single foreground object, but they do not generate complete scenes with backgrounds.
Scene-level methods [ 75 , 35 ] synthesize complete dynamic scenes as a single holistic representation, making object-level editing difficult.
Moreover, because geometry is reconstructed from a limited set of generated viewpoints, rendering quality often degrades under novel-view changes.
These challenges are further amplified by the scarcity of large-scale dynamic-scene datasets, which forces many methods to rely on distillation from image or video generative priors.
Although such priors provide useful supervision, the resulting 4D content remains constrained by their quality and failure modes.
Furthermore, when artifacts appear in the generated content, even localized errors require regenerating the entire sequence, making correction costly and prone to inconsistencies with the original output.
In real production workflows, where expert-driven refinement is often necessary, this lack of editability becomes a significant limitation.
These observations suggest that constructing 4D scenes as composable assets, rather than as a single monolithic video, offers a more flexible alternative.
Asset-based generation naturally aligns with graphics workflows, allowing creators to manipulate and replace scene components with greater control.
However, editable 4D scene construction remains underexplored, as existing pipelines often couple backgrounds with dynamic elements and make independent editing difficult.
blocks.zh:
现有的文本到4D方法大致可以分为对象级和场景级方法.
对象级方法 [2,79] 经常通过聚焦于单个前地对象来产生多视图一致的动态主题,但它们不会产生有背景的完整场景.
场景级别方法 [75,35] 将完整的动态场景合成为单一的整体表现,使对象级别编辑变得困难.
此外,由于几何是从有限的一组生成的观点来重建的,使得质量在新颖的视角变化下往往会退化.
大规模动态场景数据集的稀缺进一步加剧了这些挑战,这迫使许多方法依赖从图像或视频基因前传中分馏.
虽然这些前科提供了有用的监督,但由此产生的4D内容仍然受到质量和故障模式的限制.
此外,当人工制品出现在生成的内容中时,即使是局部出错也需要重新生成整个序列,使校正费用高昂并容易与原始产出相矛盾.
在实际生产工作流程中,往往需要专家推动的完善,这种缺乏可编辑性成为了一个重要的限制.
这些观察表明,将4D场景建设为可混凝土资产,而不是单一的单片视频,提供了一个更灵活的替代方案.
基于资产的生成自然地与图形工作流程相匹配,使创建者能够以更大的控制来操纵并取代场景组件.
然而,可编辑的4D场景构造仍然未得到充分探索,因为现有的管线经常会将具有动态元素的背景混为一谈并使得独立编辑变得困难.

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, we introduce Edit4D, an editable text-to-4D framework that constructs 4D scenes from separate background scene and dynamic character representations.
Given a user instruction, Edit4D first decomposes it into stage-specific prompts for background, dynamic character, and composition.
We then generate the 4D scene through parallel background scene and dynamic character generation, followed by scene–character composition.
The background scene is reconstructed as a 3D Gaussian representation from multi-view images synthesized using text-to-image and camera-conditioned generative priors.
For the dynamic character, we generate a reference video by animating a character image, reconstructing a temporally consistent 4D mesh, and binding Gaussian primitives to obtain a dynamic character representation.
The composition stage localizes the target placement region with text-guided masks and optimizes the character pose using contact-aware constraints.
We further perform a global scene refinement to improve appearance consistency and rendering details.
Extensive experiments show that Edit4D achieves state-of-the-art performance against recent 4D generation methods, while additionally supporting controllable camera motion.
We illustrate the overview of our method in Fig. Edit4D: Editable 4D Scene Generation with Textual Control .

对于动态人物,我们通过动画人物形象,重建时间上一致的4D网格来生成参考视频,并捆绑高斯原始人以获得动态人物代表.
组成阶段将目标布置区域定位为有文字制导口罩,并使用接触-意识约束来优化角色布置.

blocks.en: We summarize our contributions as follows: • We propose Edit4D, an editable text-to-4D framework that constructs 4D scenes by composing separate background and dynamic character representations through a stage-specific generation pipeline. This component-wise design enables independent editing, flexible control, and scene recomposition within a unified 4D space. • We introduce a text-guided composition method that automatically places a dynamic character into a background scene. Our method localizes target region from text and optimizes character position with contact and penetration constraints, reducing the need for manual placement. • Edit4D achieves state-of-the-art performance compared with recent 4D generation methods while preserving high perceptual quality. Beyond generation quality, it supports camera control and fine-grained object-level editing.
blocks.zh: 我们总结我们的贡献如下: • 我们提议Edit4D,一个可编辑的文本到4D框架,通过不同阶段的生成程序,将不同的背景和动态字符表示组成4D场景. 这种构件式设计可以在统一的4D空间内实现独立编辑,灵活控制,并进行场景再组合. ^ 我们引入了以文字为指南的构成方法,自动将动态字符放入背景场景. 我们的方法将目标区域从文本本地化,并在接触和穿透限制下优化字符位置,减少人工放置的需要. • 与最近的4D生成方法相比,Edit4D实现了最先进的性能,同时保持了高知觉质量。 超越生成质量,它支持相机控制和细纹对象级编辑.

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: 2.1 3D and 4D Scene Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 三维和四维场景生成

blocks.en:
Text-to-3D generation has advanced rapidly with the development of large-scale generative models.
Score distillation sampling (SDS)-based methods [ 46 , 64 , 8 , 30 , 80 , 31 ] synthesize 3D content by aligning rendered views with text-conditioned diffusion priors, but they are computationally expensive and often suffer from view-dependent artifacts and the Janus problem.
Recent multi-view guided methods address these limitations by generating geometrically consistent views and then lifting them into 3D representations.
Text-conditioned [ 25 , 53 , 26 , 19 ] and image-conditioned [ 60 , 33 , 32 , 37 , 71 ] approaches follow this paradigm to improve visual fidelity and efficiency.
More recently, data-driven models [ 78 , 68 , 57 ] trained on large-scale 3D datasets generate 3D from text or image inputs.
blocks.zh:
文本到3D的生成随着大规模基因模型的发展而迅速进步.
分数分馏采样(SDS)基于方法[46,64,8,30,80,31]通过将渲染的观点与文本条件的传播前作相配合来合成3D内容,但它们在计算上昂贵并经常会受取景文物和Janus问题所苦.
最近的多观点指导方法通过产生几何上一致的观点,再将其提升为三维表达,来解决这些局限性.
文字条件[25、53、26、19]和图像条件[60、33、32、37、71]采用这一模式,以提高视觉忠诚和效率。
最近,数据驱动的模型[78.,68.,57]接受了大规模3D数据集的培训,从文本或图像输入生成了3D.

blocks.en:
Building on these advances, recent text- or video-to-4D methods [ 44 , 49 , 50 , 54 , 56 , 74 , 79 , 2 , 75 , 35 ] synthesize dynamic 3D content using diffusion guidance, multi-view generation, or SDS-based optimization.
Object-level methods such as 4Dfy [ 2 ] and Dream-in-4D [ 79 ] can produce temporally coherent and multi-view consistent dynamic objects.
Scene-level methods such as 4Real [ 75 ] and Free4D [ 35 ] instead generate complete dynamic scenes, improving photorealism or temporal consistency through video-conditioned reconstruction or point-guided denoising.
However, these methods typically perform holistic 4D synthesis, making it difficult to isolate and control individual scene components after generation.
In contrast, Edit4D constructs 4D scenes from separate representations, enabling fine-grained modification while preserving spatio-temporal coherence.
blocks.zh:
在这些进展的基础上,近期的文本-或视频-到4D方法[44,49,50,54,56,74,79,2,75,35]利用传播指导,多视图生成,或基于SDS的优化来合成动态3D内容.
4Dfy [2]和Dream-in-4D [79]等对象级方法可以产生时间上一致和多视图一致的动态对象.
场景级方法如4Real [75]和Free4D [35] 取而代之的是产生完整的动态场景,通过视频条件重建或指向去Noing来提高光现实主义或时间一致性.
然而,这些方法通常进行整体的4D合成,使得在生成后难以孤立和控制单个场景组件.
相形之下,Edit4D从单独的表达方式中构建出4D场景,在保持斯皮提奥-时相一致性的同时,能够进行精细的修改.

Figure 3 : Detailed Generation Pipeline of Edit4D. In the first stage, Edit4D decomposes a user instruction into background scene text, character appearance and motion text, and composition text for target placement via off-the-shelf large language model.
In the second stage, our framework generates background scene and dynamic character.
A background scene is generated as a 3D Gaussian representation using text- and camera-conditioned priors.
It then constructs a dynamic 3D character via video-guided mesh reconstruction and Gaussian binding.

Finally, we perform a global scene refinement to improve appearance harmonization and rendering consistency.

blocks.en: 2.2 Scene Representation
blocks.zh: 2.2 现场代表

blocks.en:
Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) [ 38 ] established a foundation for neural 3D scene representations through volumetric rendering.
Although NeRF achieves high visual fidelity, its slow rendering speed motivated more efficient variants such as Instant-NGP [ 41 ] and HexPlane [ 5 ] , which leverage hash-based or tensor-decomposed encodings.
More recently, Gaussian Splatting [ 22 ] introduced a rasterization-based representation using Gaussian primitives, enabling real-time rendering with high visual quality.
This line of work has been extended to dynamic 4D representations, including NeRFPlayer [ 55 ] , 4D-GS [ 66 ] , and Grid4D [ 69 ] , which jointly model spatial structure and temporal motion.
However, accurately recovering geometry remains challenging when optimization relies mainly on photometric supervision.
Recent methods such as SuGaR [ 13 ] and 2D Gaussian [ 18 ] redesign Gaussian primitives to align with underlying surfaces, while structure-guided frameworks like GaussianAvatar [ 40 , 17 ] and Mani-GS [ 10 ] attach the Gaussians to deformable meshes for stable geometry.
blocks.zh:
神经辐射场 (NERF) [38] 为神经3D场景通过体积渲染表达建立了基础.
虽然NERF实现了高视觉忠心度,但其缓慢渲染速度激发出更高效的变体,如Instant-NGP [41]和HexPlane [5],这些变体能利用以散列为主或由拉诺分解而成的编码.
最近,高斯平板化[22]采用了以光栅化为主的以高斯原始为主的表示法,使得能以高视觉质量进行实时渲染.
此行被扩展至动态4D表示,包括NERFPlayer [55],4D-GS [66],和Grid4D [69],它们共同模拟了空间结构和时间运动.
然而,精确地恢复几何仍然具有挑战性,因为优化主要依靠光度监督。
近代方法如SuGaR [13]和2D Gaussian [18] 重新设计高斯原始物以与基础地表相配合,而高斯亚活佛[40,17]和Mani-GS [10]等结构制导框架则将高斯亚人附以可变形的 meshes用于稳定的几何.

blocks.en: 2.3 Scene Composition
blocks.zh: 2.3 场景构成

blocks.en:
With recent advances in segmentation foundation models [ 23 , 76 ] , mask-based composition methods in 3D neural scenes have been actively studied.
By leveraging 2D masks from segmentation or text-to-mask models, prior methods localize editable regions for object removal and inpainting, ensuring reliable composition [ 3 , 73 , 52 ] .
More closely related to our work, human-scene placement methods aim to place human in 3D scene with physically plausible contact while reducing interpenetration artifacts.
PROX [ 14 ] fits SMPL-X [ 45 ] bodies to scenes using contact and penetration constraints, and POSA [ 15 ] learns a body-centric contact representation for plausible placements.
Furthermore, COINS [ 77 ] and Narrator [ 70 ] refine using contact optimization to encourage natural human-scene contact.
However, these methods typically assume reconstructed real scenes, supervised interaction data, or manually prepared assets.
In contrast, Edit4D performs text-driven scene–character composition, allowing dynamic characters to be automatically placed into generated background scenes through text-guided segmentation and contact-aware optimization.
blocks.zh:
随着分化基础模型的近期进步[23,76],3D神经场景中的口罩成份方法被积极研究.
通过利用从分块或文本到任务模型的2D口罩,先前的方法将可编辑区域本地化,用于对象去除和涂抹,确保可靠的组成[3,73,52].
更贴近我们的工作, 人-场布置方法 旨在将人放在 3D 场景 与物理上可信的接触, 同时减少 互渗透的文物。
PROX [14] 适合SMPL-X [45] 身体使用接触和穿透限制的场景,POSA [15] 学习以身体为中心的接触代表,以合理定位.
此外,COINS[77]和Narrator[70]利用接触优化来改进,以鼓励自然的人类相接触。
然而,这些方法通常假定重建真实场景,监督互动数据,或人工制备资产。
相形之下,Edit4D执行由文本驱动的场景-特征构成,允许动态字符通过文本引导分解和接触意识优化自动被放入生成的背景场景.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We propose Edit4D, a unified framework for generating editable 4D scenes from textual descriptions.
As shown in Fig. 3 , our framework composes independently generated background scenes and dynamic characters into a unified 4D representation, enabling object-level editing and recomposition.
We first describe our editable 4D scene representation based on Gaussian splatting.
We then explain how Edit4D constructs a 4D scene through a stage-specific generation pipeline using off-the-shelf generative priors.
blocks.zh:
我们提议Edit4D,一个从文字描述生成可编辑的4D场景的统一框架.
如图3所示,我们的框架独立地将背景场景和动态字符编成一个统一的4D代表,使对象级编辑和再组合成为可能.
我们首先根据高斯滑板来描述我们可编辑的4D场景表现.
然后我们解释Edit4D如何通过一个阶段特定的生成管道,利用现成的基因前传构建出一个4D场景.

blocks.en: 3.2 Stage 1: Instruction Decomposition
blocks.zh: 3.2 第一阶段:指令分解

blocks.en:
Edit4D takes a single user instruction that describes the background scene, dynamic character, and scene–character composition.
Since each module requires different information, the original instruction is not directly suitable for all stages of the pipeline.
We therefore use a large language model [ 42 ] to convert the user instruction into stage-specific prompts while preserving its original semantics.
As shown in Fig. 3 , the decomposed prompts guide background scene generation, dynamic 3D character generation, and scene–character composition.
This instruction decomposition allows each module to operate with an appropriate prompt and enables the overall pipeline to run automatically from a single user instruction.
blocks.zh:
Edit4D 需要一个单一的用户指令来描述背景场景,动态字符,和场景 - 特征构成.
由于每个模块都需要不同的信息,原指令并不直接适合管道的所有阶段.
因此,我们使用一个大语言模型[42],在保留其原始语义的同时,将用户指令转换为特定阶段的提示.
如图3所示,被分解的提示会引导背景场景生成,动态3D字符生成,以及场景-特征构成.
这种指令分解使每个模块能够以适当的即时操作,并使整个管道能够从单一用户指令中自动运行.

blocks.en: 3.3 Stage 2: Background Scene Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 第2阶段:背景场景生成

blocks.en:
To generate a background scene, we first synthesize a high-quality scene image from the background scene text.
This image serves as a reference that defines the overall layout, appearance, and semantic structure of the scene.
We then employ a camera-conditioned multi-view generation model to expand the image into a set of geometrically consistent views along sampled camera trajectories.
These generated views provide additional spatial observations and parallax cues necessary for reliable 3D reconstruction.
Finally, we reconstruct a background Gaussian splatting representation from the generated multi-view observations, yielding a globally consistent background representation 𝒢 bg \mathcal{G}^{\text{bg}} .
blocks.zh:
为了生成背景场景,我们首先从背景场景文本中合成出高质量的场景图像.
这个图像作为一个参考,定义了场景的整体布局,外观,和语义结构.
然后我们使用一个相机条件的多视图生成模型,沿着被取样的相机轨迹来将图像扩展成一组几何一致的视图.
这些所产生的观点为可靠的立体重建提供了必要的额外空间观测和参数提示。
最后,我们从产生的多视图观测中重建出一个背景高斯滑板代表,形成全球一致的背景代表G bg\mathcal{G}^{\text{bg}}}.

blocks.en: 3.4 Stage 2: Dynamic 3D Character Generation
blocks.zh: 3.4 第2阶段:动态三维字符生成

blocks.en:
We use a text-to-image model to generate a character image and animate it with the image-conditioned video generator.
Given the generated video, we employ a mesh estimator [ 7 ] to reconstruct a deformable mesh sequence { 𝐌 t } t = 1 T \{\mathbf{M}_{t}\}_{t=1}^{T} with temporally consistent topology across time.
To enable joint rendering with the background scene, we convert the mesh sequence into a 4D Gaussian splatting representation using the mesh-binding scheme following [ 10 ] to exploit mesh topology.
Specifically, Gaussians are attached to mesh faces and updated according to the underlying mesh deformation, providing a topology-aware dynamic representation.

Moreover, we measure background preservation using CLIP [ 47 ] and DINO [ 43 ] similarities after masking the character regions.
For the editing evaluation, we additionally conduct a user study to assess how well the remaining scene content is preserved after editing.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Study

blocks.en:
We conduct ablation studies to analyze how each component of Edit4D affects scene–character composition and 4D generation quality.
Tab. 4 shows that removing initialization, contact loss, penetration loss, and global refinement degrades different metrics, while the full model achieves the best quantitative results.
Fig. 7 further visualizes the effect of each composition component.
Without initialization, the optimization often converges to an incorrect placement, whereas removing the contact loss causes the character to float above the support surface, and removing the penetration loss results in penetration into the scene geometry.
These results indicate that each constraint and refinement provide complementary benefits for robust placement, visual quality, and scene coherence.
Moreover, Fig. 8 demonstrates the effect of the global refinement stage.
The refinement stage enhances fine-grained details while improving the overall visual coherence of the composed 4D scene.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we presented Edit4D, a framework for editable 4D scene generation that separates background scenes and dynamic characters for object-level control and composition.
Quantitative evaluations on VBench demonstrate state-of-the-art generation quality, while our editability evaluation shows that Edit4D better preserves unedited scene content and reduces editing time compared with holistic regeneration.
Qualitative results further demonstrate that Edit4D produces coherent 4D scenes and remains robust under large camera viewpoint changes, supporting reliable novel-view synthesis and dynamic camera control.
Our analysis validates the effectiveness of text-guided composition and contact-aware optimization for semantically and physically plausible character placement.
Together, these results show that Edit4D provides a practical and flexible framework for high-quality editable 4D scene generation.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们提出了"Edit4D"(Edit4D),这是可编辑的4D场景生成的框架,将背景场景和动态字符分开,用于对象级别控制和组成.
V Bench的定量评价展现出最先进的一代质量,而我们的可编辑性评价显示Edit4D比整体再生更好地保存了未经编辑的场景内容并减少了编辑时间.
定性结果还进一步证明Edit4D产生连贯的4D场景,并在大型相机视距变化下保持稳健,支持可靠的新视觉合成和动态相机控制.
我们的分析验证了文本指导成分的有效性,以及优化接触意识,以便进行精密和物理上可信的字符定位。
这些结果表明Edit4D为高质量可编辑的4D场景生成提供了实用而灵活的框架.

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation details
blocks.zh: 附录A

blocks.en:
We describe the implementation of Edit4D by summarizing each component: instruction decomposition, background scene generation, dynamic 3D character generation, scene–character composition, and global scene refinement.
Importantly, Edit4D is not tied to the specific pretrained models used in our implementation.
Each stage is modular and can be replaced by an alternative model with compatible input and output representations, allowing the framework to incorporate different open-source models without changing the overall pipeline.
blocks.zh:
我们通过总结每个组件来描述Edit4D的实施:指令分解,背景场景生成,动态三维字符生成,场景-特征组成,以及全局场景的完善.
重要的是,Edit4D没有与我们实施过程中使用的具体预先培训的模式挂钩。
每个阶段都是模块化的,可以被一个具有相容输入和输出表示的替代模型所取而代之,使框架能够整合不同的开源模型而无需改变整个管道.

blocks.en: A.1 Instruction Decomposition
blocks.zh: A.1 指令分解

blocks.en:
We use GPT v5.2 [ 42 ] to decompose a user instruction into stage-specific prompts for background scene generation, character generation, motion generation, and scene–character composition. Each prompt contains only the information required by its corresponding stage, allowing the pipeline to operate automatically from a single user instruction while preventing unnecessary information from being propagated across stages.
The instruction template is summarized in Table 5 .

blocks.en: A.2 Background Scene Generation
blocks.zh: A.2 背景场景生成

blocks.en:
Given a textual scene description, we first synthesize a frontal background scene image ( 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 ) using a text-to-image model [ 65 ] .
To enable 3D reconstruction, we then generate a set of geometrically consistent multi-view images by extending the frontal view to additional camera poses via a multi-view generation framework.
The resulting multi-view set is used to estimate a 3D Gaussian splatting representation of the background.
In our implementation, we use VistaDream [ 62 ] to jointly produce trajectory-conditioned multi-view inpainting images and reconstruct the background Gaussian splatting in a unified pipeline.

blocks.en: A.3 Dynamic 3D Character Generation
blocks.zh: A.3 动态 三维字符生成

blocks.en:
We generate a dynamic character in five steps: (1) image generation, (2) image-conditioned video generation, (3) 4D mesh estimation, (4) multi-view rendering, and (5) training dynamic Gaussian splatting.
We first synthesize a character image ( 800 × 800 800\times 800 ) from a text prompt, and then generate an image-aligned motion video ( 800 × 800 800\times 800 , 60 frames) using an image- and text-conditioned video model [ 61 ] .
The temporally consistent 4D mesh sequence is reconstructed using Motion 3-to-4 [ 7 ] , which estimates a canonical reference mesh and predicts per-frame vertex trajectories to recover temporally coherent geometry.
blocks.zh:
我们以五个步骤产生动态字符:(1) 图像生成,(2) 图像条件视频生成,(3) 4D网目估计,(4) 多视图渲染,和(5) 训练动态高斯电镀.
我们首先从文本提示中合成出一个人物图像(800×800800\times 800),然后用图像和文本条件的视频模型生成一个图像相通的运动视频(800×800800\times 800,60帧)[61].
时间上一致的4D网格序列是用Motion 3-to-4 [7]来重建的,它估计出一个犬形参考网格并预测出每帧顶点的轨迹来恢复时间上一致的几何.

blocks.en:
To render the character together with the Gaussian splatting background efficiently, we convert the 4D mesh to a dynamic Gaussian representation.
Specifically, we render multi-view images in Blender [ 4 ] using 30 cameras uniformly distributed on a sphere and bind Gaussian primitives to mesh faces following Mani-GS [ 10 ] , so that Gaussians follow mesh deformations over time.
To further improve temporal stability under non-rigid deformation, we incorporate a lightweight deformation field following [ 72 ] that predicts per-time offsets of Gaussian position, rotation, scale, and color.
We execute all of the image and video generation steps in ComfyUI [ 9 ] .
Moreover, to improve generation quality, we additionally employ task-specific positive and negative prompts to suppress common generation artifacts (e.g., shadows, background leakage, and watermark-like artifacts).
blocks.zh:

具体地说,我们利用30个统一分布在球体上的相机在 Blender [4] 中制作多视图图像,并将高斯原始人绑在跟随Mani-GS [10] 的网状面上,从而使高斯人随网状变形随时间推移而来.

blocks.en:
Given the background and dynamic character Gaussians, we optimize a single global rigid transform of the character, parameterized by a global rotation and translation.
The rotation is applied around the character center, followed by translation, while the character scale is fixed to a predefined value between 0.6 and 1.2.
We initialize the character position using the bounding boxes of the character mesh and the target Gaussians.
Specifically, we first align the character center with the center of the target region.
Following the y y -down coordinate convention, we then apply a small offset along the negative y y -axis to place the character slightly above the support surface before optimization.
This initialization provides a stable starting point for subsequent contact-aware optimization.
Next, we minimize a weighted sum of contact and penetration losses for 1000 iterations: ℒ composition = λ contact ​ ℒ contact + λ penetration ​ ℒ penetration . \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{\text{composition}}=\lambda_{\text{contact}}\mathcal{L}_{\text{contact}}+\lambda_{\text{penetration}}\mathcal{L}_{\text{penetration}}. (11) In our experiments, we set λ contact = 10 2 \lambda_{\text{contact}}=10^{2} and λ penetration = 10 4 \lambda_{\text{penetration}}=10^{4} , assigning a stronger penalty to interpenetration.
For the penetration loss, we precompute a signed distance field (SDF) from the character mesh on a 128 3 128^{3} grid with a padding of 0.05 0.05 , where negative SDF values indicate points inside the character mesh.
During optimization, scene points are transformed into the character coordinate system and queried against the SDF using trilinear interpolation.
Points with negative SDF values are penalized to discourage interpenetration.
The optimized global transform is then applied consistently to the dynamic character Gaussians across all frames.

blocks.en: A.6 Runtime

blocks.en:
On a single RTX Pro 6000 Blackwell GPU, Edit4D takes on average approximately 2 hours per example: 10 minutes for static scene generation, 70 minutes for dynamic character generation, 1 minute for composition, and 45 minutes for global scene refinement.
This staged design enables component-level editing of the background scene, dynamic character, and their composition, which is difficult in holistic video-to-4D pipelines.

blocks.en:
We also compare the runtime of prior text-to-4D methods with publicly available code when generating the same number of frames as Edit4D.
4D-fy and Dream-in-4D typically require more than 24 hours per example due to expensive computation of radiance field and score distillation sampling-based optimization, while Free4D takes approximately 3 hours when including multi-view video generation and 4D Gaussian optimization.
More importantly, when editing an existing scene, holistic 4D generation pipelines generally require regenerating the entire 4D result from scratch.
Edit4D can instead reuse pre-generated background and character assets, requiring only scene-character composition and optional global scene refinement.
This substantially reduces the cost of iterative editing and makes Edit4D a more practical framework for controllable 4D scene creation.
blocks.zh:
我们还在生成与Edit4D相同的帧数时,将先前文本到4D方法的运行时间与可公开使用的代码进行比较.
4D-fy和Dream-in-4D一般需要超过24小时的每个实例,因为昂贵地计算出光场和分数分馏采样优化,而Free4D在包含多视视频生成和4D高斯优化时需要约3小时.
更重要的是,在编辑一个已存在的场景时,整体的4D生成管一般需要从零开始再生整个4D结果.
Edit4D可以转而再利用预先生成的背景和字符资产,只需要场景-特征组成和可选的全球场景改进.
这大大降低了迭代编辑的成本,使Edit4D成为更实用的可控4D场景创建框架.

In Table 7 , we compare Edit4D with existing text-to-4D generation methods in terms of their capabilities.
Specifically, we compare representative scene-level and object-level methods with respect to input modality, output representation, scene–character separation, component-level editing, and character composition.
Existing methods typically generate a holistic dynamic scene representation in which the background and dynamic characters are tightly coupled.
In contrast, Edit4D represents the background scene and dynamic characters as separate Gaussian representations, enabling independent component-level editing and flexible scene–character composition.

blocks.en:
We conducted an anonymous pairwise user study comparing Edit4D with Free4D [ 35 ] .
A total of 25 participants evaluated the rendered 4D scenes through a web-based interface, where the two methods were presented as Video A and Video B without revealing the method names.
The scene order and the left–right placement of the two methods were randomized to reduce presentation bias.
For a fair comparison, we regenerated the Free4D results using its publicly available implementation.
Since Free4D requires a reference video, we generated the corresponding inputs using the same Qwen [ 58 ] and WAN [ 61 ] based generation pipeline used for Edit4D, with the same video resolution and frame setting.
Both methods were rendered from multiple viewpoints for comparison.
For the original 4D scenes, participants compared 13 scenes and answered two questions regarding 3D Structure and Visual Quality.
Specifically, participants selected which result better preserved the perceived 3D structure of the scene and which result appeared visually better.
We additionally evaluated editability using five scenes for both scene–character recomposition and character appearance editing.
For each method, participants were shown the result before and after editing and asked which method better preserved the background content after the edit.
An example of the evaluation interface is shown in Fig. 9 .

为了进行公平比较,我们利用公开执行的结果重新产生了Free4D的结果。

这两种方法都是从多种角度进行比较的。
对于最初的4D场景,参与者比较了13场景并回答了关于3D结构与视觉质量的两个问题.
具体地说,与会者选择哪些结果更好地保留了场景的3D结构,哪些结果看起来更好。
我们利用5个场景来评估可编辑性,

blocks.en: Appendix E Evaluation on Editability
blocks.zh: 附录E 关于可编辑性的评价

blocks.en:
We further evaluate the editability of Edit4D through character appearance editing and scene–character recomposition.
We compare against Free4D, which, to our knowledge, is the only scene-level text-to-4D generation method with publicly available source code, allowing us to directly reproduce its pipeline for controlled editing comparisons.
Since Free4D represents the scene holistically, each edit requires full regeneration of the 4D scene.
For a fair comparison, we generate the edited reference videos using the same video generation model as Edit4D and run Free4D using its publicly released implementation and settings.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步通过人物外观编辑和场景-特征再组合来评价Edit4D的可编辑性.
我们与Free4D比较,据我们所知,Free4D是唯一具有公开源代码的场景级文本到4D生成方法,使我们能够直接复制其管道来进行有控制的编辑比较.
自从自由4 D整体代表了场景,每次编辑都需要全面再生4D场景.
为了进行公平的比较,我们使用与Edit4D相同的视频生成模型生成所编辑的参考视频,并使用其公开发布的执行和设置运行Free4D.

blocks.en:
Our evaluation focuses on how well the unedited background is preserved after editing.
We evaluate five character scenes for each of the two editing tasks and compare the original and edited renderings across multiple camera viewpoints and time steps shown in Fig. 10 .
To prevent changes in character position, scale, or appearance from affecting the evaluation, we localize the character using Grounding DINO [ 34 ] and apply a shared mask covering the union of the character regions in the original and edited images.
Thus, the evaluation measures the consistency of the background outside the edited region.
blocks.zh:
我们评价的重点是编辑后如何保存未经编辑的背景。
我们为两个编辑任务分别评价了五个角色场景,并比较了图10中显示的多相机视角和时间步骤的原始和被编辑的渲染.
为防止角色位置,尺度或外观的变化会影响评价,我们使用Grounding DINO[34]对角色进行本地化,并在原始和编辑的图像中应用覆盖角色区域结合的共享口罩.
因此,评价衡量编辑区域以外背景的一致性。

blocks.en:
We assess editing success using three VLMs, GLM-4.6 [ 59 ] , Qwen3-VL [ 58 ] , and Mistral-3.1 [ 1 ] , based on whether the original background scene is preserved after editing.
Their decisions are aggregated across sampled viewpoints and time steps.
We separately measure background preservation using CLIP [ 47 ] and DINOv2 [ 43 ] similarities computed between the masked original and edited images, where higher similarity indicates better preservation of the unedited background.
As reported in the main paper, Edit4D consistently achieves higher editing success and background preservation than Free4D for both editing tasks while requiring substantially less editing time.
blocks.zh:
我们利用三个VLM,GLM-4.6 [59],Qune3-VL [58],和Mistral-3.1 [1],根据编辑后是否保留了原始背景场景来评估编辑成功.
它们的决定按抽样观点和时间步骤汇总。
我们使用CLIP[47]和DINOv2[43]对背景进行单独测量,计算出被遮掩的原始图像和被编辑的图像之间的相似性,其中较高的相似性表明对未经编辑的背景进行更好的保护。
如正文所报道的,Edit4D在两种编辑任务上持续实现比Free4D更高的编辑成功和背景保存,同时需要的编辑时间要少得多.

blocks.zh: 图11:Edit4D允许对象级编辑. 我们的模块化 4D 表示支持角色外观修改,资产插入,以及场景 - 特征重组,而不重新生成整个场景.

blocks.en: Appendix F Additional qualitative results
blocks.zh: 附录F 其他质量结果

blocks.en:
We provide additional qualitative results to further demonstrate the editing capability and flexibility of Edit4D.
As shown in Fig. 11 , Edit4D supports asset insertion, scene–character recomposition, and character appearance modification using the scene presented in the main paper.
In the asset insertion example, we manually place a hat represented as a Gaussian Splatting asset onto the character.
Scene–character recomposition is performed by specifying “left sofa” as the target region and repositioning the character through our composition framework.
To modify the character appearance, we construct a 3D mask for “cloth” using our masking method and update the color values within the masked region.
Since the background and character are represented as reusable 3D assets, these edits can be performed while preserving the remaining scene content without regenerating the entire 4D scene.
blocks.zh:
我们提供额外的质量结果,以进一步显示Edit4D的编辑能力和灵活性。
如图11所示,Edit4D支持资产插入,场景-特征重组,以及使用正文所呈现的场景进行字符外观修改.
在资产插入的例子中,我们手动在字符上放上一个代表为高斯克平板电脑的帽子.
通过将 " 左沙发 " 指定为目标区域并通过我们的构成框架重新定位特征来进行场景-特征再组合。
为了修改字符外观,我们用我们的遮掩方法为“穿衣”构建了3D口罩并更新被遮蔽区域内的颜色值。
由于背景和字符被表现为可再用3D资产,这些编辑可以同时保存所剩的场景内容而无需再生成整个4D场景.

blocks.en:
We further demonstrate the flexibility of our scene–character composition framework in Fig. 12 .
As shown in Fig. 12 , our framework can incorporate alternative dynamic character representations.
Specifically, we integrate Animatable Gaussians [ 28 ] and obtain plausible multi-character compositions, while visualizing left, center, and right floor masks for controllable placement.
To maximize compatibility with diverse character representations, our main pipeline adopts a video-to-mesh model that does not rely on explicit rigging or skeleton annotations.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步显示了我们现场的灵活性——图12中的特征构成框架。
如图12所示,我们的框架可以纳入其他动态特征表述。
具体地说,我们整合了Animatable Gaussians [28] 并获得了可信的多特征的构件,同时可视化地将左,中,右三层口罩用于可控放置.
为了最大限度地实现与多种性格表达的兼容性,我们的主要管道采用了一种不依赖明确装配或骨架说明的视频到图像模型。

blocks.en:
Fig. 12 further presents a more challenging interaction with a large contact area between the character and the scene.
For non-contact interactions such as hovering or flying, we replace the contact objective with a distance-thresholded variant that maintains a target distance from the scene surface.
As shown in Fig. 12 , this produces stable and non-intersecting floating characters within the same optimization framework.
Together, these results demonstrate that the proposed composition framework can accommodate diverse character representations, contact configurations, and spatial relationships.
blocks.zh:
图12还提供了更具有挑战性的互动,与角色和场景之间的大接触区.
对于诸如徘徊或飞行等非接触性相互作用,我们用一个距离阈值的变体来取而代之的是接触目标,这个变体与场景表面保持了目标距离.
如图12所示,这在同一优化框架内产生稳定而非互通的浮动字符.
这些结果共同表明,拟议的组成框架能够容纳不同的性格表现、联系组合和空间关系。

blocks.en:
In addition, we present additional generation results across diverse text prompts in Fig. 13 , showing that Edit4D consistently produces coherent and visually plausible 4D scenes.
Furthermore, Fig. 14 provides additional novel-view renderings, demonstrating that our method maintains high visual quality under large camera viewpoint changes.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们在图13中提出了不同文本提示的更多生成结果,表明Edit4D持续地产生连贯的、可视化的4D场景。
此外,图14还提供了新的小说视角渲染,表明我们的方法在大型相机视角变化下保持了高视觉质量.

blocks.zh: 图14:从正面取景所生成的4D场景和随时间推移而出现的四种多样的相机取景的额外可视化.

blocks.en: Appendix G Analysis on Contact Map
blocks.zh: 附录G 联系地图分析

blocks.en:
We visualize the contact intensity map produced by our composition stage in Fig. 15 .
Given a composition text, Edit4D first localizes the corresponding target region in the generated background scene and then optimizes the character placement using contact-aware constraints.
The high-contact regions align well with the target area specified by the composition text, showing that Edit4D can localize target placement regions and establish plausible character-scene contact.
In addition, the character contact maps show that the contact response is mainly activated around physically plausible support regions, such as the lower body or contact-facing surface of the character.
Overall, these analyses demonstrate that Edit4D enables physically plausible scene–character composition while maintaining the editability and rendering quality of the generated 4D scene.
blocks.zh:
在图15中,我们可视化我们组成阶段制作的接触强度图。
鉴于一个成分文本,Edit4D首先在生成的背景场景中将相应的目标区域本地化,然后利用接触-意识限制来优化字符定位.
高接触区域与组成文本所指定的目标区域非常一致,表明Edit4D可以将目标放置区域本地化,并建立可信的字符-场景联系.
此外,角色接触图显示,接触响应主要围绕物理上可行的支持区域启动,如角色下体或接触-外观.
总的来说,这些分析表明,Edit4D在保持所生成的4D场景的可编辑性和渲染质量的同时,可以使场景-特征构成具有物理上的可信性。

blocks.en:
Figure 15 : Rendered contact map from 3D visualizer.
Black and blue indicate the scene object and character, respectively, while brighter yellow represents higher contact intensity. We also visualize the target object mask in the figure.
blocks.zh:
图15:由3D可视化器绘制出的联系人地图.
黑色和蓝色分别表示场景对象和人物,而更亮的黄色代表了更高的接触强度. 我们还将图中的目标物体口罩进行可视化.

blocks.en:
Figure 16 : Failure case caused by an occluded composition target.
The partially hidden chair produces an incomplete target region, leading to inaccurate character placement and intersection with the desk geometry in rotated views.
blocks.zh:
图16:未实现的成分目标造成的故障。
部分隐藏的相椅产生不完整的目标区域,导致角色定位不准确,并会与桌上几何相交相旋转视图.

blocks.en: Appendix H Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录H 限制

blocks.en:
Our scene–character composition relies on text-guided segmentation to identify the target region for character placement.
Therefore, the target object should be sufficiently visible and spatially localized in the input scene.
Fig. 16 shows a representative failure case in which the target chair is partially occluded by the desk.
Although the visible chair region can be identified, the incomplete target region leads to inaccurate character placement and intersection with the surrounding desk geometry.
This limitation could be alleviated by incorporating stronger 3D scene understanding or occlusion-aware target completion into the composition process.
blocks.zh:
我们的场景 - 特征组成依赖于文本引导的分块来识别目标区域进行字符定位.
因此,目标物体应当在输入场景中有足够的可见度和空间定位.
图16显示一个有代表性的故障情况,即目标主席部分被办公桌占用。
虽然可以识别出可见的椅子区域,但不完整的目标区域会导致角色定位不准确并和周围的台地几何相交.
这种限制可以通过将更强的三维场景理解或隔离意识目标完成纳入组成过程来缓解.

blocks.en:
Our pipeline also relies on several pretrained modules for intermediate predictions.
Errors from these components can propagate to the final 4D scene.
For example, imperfect dynamic character reconstruction may introduce temporal or geometric inconsistencies, while inaccurate text-guided segmentation can lead to errors in target localization and composition.
Similarly, artifacts in the generated image or reference video can affect the quality of the reconstructed scene or character.
Although our refinement stage can alleviate moderate inconsistencies, severe upstream errors may still remain in the final result.
Improving robustness to such intermediate prediction errors remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh:
我们的管道还依靠几个经过预先训练的模块进行中间预测。
这些组件的错误可以传播到最后的4D场景.
例如,不完善的动态字符重建可能引入时空或几何不一致,而不准确的文本引导分解可能导致目标定位和组成出错.
同样地,生成的图像或参考视频中的文物会影响被重建的场景或人物的质量.
虽然我们的完善阶段可以缓解中度的不一致,但严重的上游错误仍然可能在最终结果中。
提高这种中间预测错误的稳健性仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: Appendix I Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录一 今后的工作

blocks.en:
Edit4D opens several directions for extending editable 4D scene generation.
One promising direction is to incorporate more diverse editable assets into the component-wise representation.
Since Edit4D constructs background scenes and dynamic characters as separate 3D components, these assets can be inserted or reused across different compositions.
Another useful extension is interactive control over scene–character composition, where users can refine placement, contact regions, and spatial relationships after generation.
Improving target localization under occlusion through stronger 3D scene understanding or target completion could further increase the robustness of composition.
In addition, reducing sensitivity to errors in text-guided segmentation, dynamic character reconstruction, and generated reference images or videos would improve consistency in challenging cases.
These directions would further connect text-driven 4D generation with practical graphics-based editing workflows.
blocks.zh:
Edit4D为扩展可编辑的4D场景生成打开了多个方向.
一个有希望的方向是将更多样化的可编辑资产纳入按构成部分分列的表述。
由于Edit4D将背景场景和动态字符构建为独立的3D组件,这些资产可以被插入或再用到不同成分中.
另一个有用的扩展是对场景-特征组成的交互控制,用户可以在场景-特征构成中完善位置,接触区域,以及生成后的空间关系.
通过加强3D场景理解或目标完成,改善隔离下的目标本地化,可进一步提高构成的稳健性。
此外,降低对文本引导分区、动态字符重建以及生成的参考图像或视频中错误的敏感性,将提高挑战性案例的一致性。
这些方向将进一步将由文本驱动的4D生成与基于实用图形的编辑工作流程相连接.
